build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake and setuptools for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension module like gtn._graph or gtn._autograd using the CMakeBuild command
review_cmakebuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that validates cmake version and builds gtn C++ extensions
review_cmakeextension_class: review the CMakeExtension class that wraps setuptools Extension for cmake-based builds
run_gtn_setup: run the gtn setup.py to install the package with seven C++ extension modules
